decisions.reason: The É accent's exact literal correspondence to the Hero V terminal was already required, and message 128 reports failure to meet that existing rule rather than changing its value.
Increasing the lowercase v's derived right-arm reach does not change the already approved Hero V master geometry.
The refinement concerns the lowercase v and É accent, not the deferred construction or character of the E and L letterforms.
The lowercase v geometry refinement does not alter the deferred champagne-gold material treatment.
The subtle right-arm extension does not necessarily change the deferred wordmark kerning and rhythm requirement.
The lowercase v construction decision is unrelated to accessible review-image formats.
